featured_reviews.name: Bijit Mandodi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello everyone, I had a very bad experience at the Babubhai Jagjivan store in Dadar. I was looking for a pant piece and was shown some so-called branded fabrics by a salesman. However, after checking online, I found that the brand he mentioned doesn't even manufacture such products. When I questioned him, he began arguing, and later showed me other fabrics with brand tags—which also turned out to be fake. They are charging customers using big brand names but selling fake materials. Please be cautious.

After 9 months, you're finally replying to my review. That alone shows how seriously you take customer feedback and your so-called ethics. Fortunately, I did not purchase anything after realizing the product was fake, so there is no question of providing a bill.
I also think there is some confusion about the meaning of "immediately." Responding after 9 months can hardly be called prompt action. If this is considered fast-track service, then that's quite concerning.
I would suggest being more careful with the words you use, because such statements are difficult to accept when they don't match the reality of the situation.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are sorry to read about your experience and take such concerns very seriously. Babubhai Jagjivandas has built its reputation over many decades on customer trust, and we do not support or encourage any misrepresentation of fabric brands, composition, or quality.

We request you to kindly share your bill number, date of visit, and details of the fabric/brand discussed, or visit the store with the fabric/bill, so that our senior team can personally verify the matter. If there has been any error or wrong communication by our staff, we will take corrective action immediately.

We would also like to clarify that there are other stores operating in the same complex, including adjacent stores, and there have been instances where they have misused our name and misrepresented to customers. We request customers to kindly check the invoice/bill printout and confirm that it clearly mentions Babubhai Jagjivandas before attributing the purchase or experience to our store.

At Babubhai Jagjivandas, we stock both branded and selected non-branded fabrics, and our staff is expected to clearly explain the difference to customers. If you read a branded fabric name on a selvedge, then rest assured it is produced directly from that fabric mill. We will review this matter internally and reinforce staff training to ensure that no customer feels misled.

Please visit the store and ask for Mr Ritesh - Manager. We would appreciate the opportunity to verify the facts and resolve the matter fairly.

featured_reviews.name: sunil kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst experience of my life. Sales persons are arrogant and mostly of bygone era who don’t know how to handle customers and complaints. Though I had purchased from this shop earlier and never experienced any issues, however, of late their cloth quality has deteriorated or they are selling fake products. After 3-4 months my trousers have given up and they refused to hear any thing. Sick people, full of arrogance. Even owners are not afraid of losing a customer.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are sorry to read about your experience and regret that you felt unheard during your visit. This is not the standard of service we expect from our team.

We take concerns regarding fabric quality very seriously. Fabric performance can depend on the type of fabric, usage, washing method, stitching, and other factors, but we would not like to comment without personally inspecting the trousers and checking the purchase details.

We request you to kindly share your bill number and date of purchase, or visit the store with the trousers and invoice, so that our senior team can examine the matter properly. If there has been any issue with the product or any incorrect handling of your complaint by our staff, we will take appropriate corrective action.

We would also like to clarify that Babubhai Jagjivandas does not knowingly sell fake products or misrepresent fabric quality. We stock predominantly branded fabrics but also have selected non-branded fabrics, and customers should always be clearly informed about what they are purchasing.

Your feedback about staff behaviour and complaint handling has been noted seriously. We will review this internally and reinforce the importance of respectful communication with every customer.

Please visit the store and ask for Mr. Ritesh - Manager. We would appreciate the opportunity to verify the issue and resolve it fairly.

featured_reviews.name: akash molavade
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited a clothing shop expecting a pleasant shopping experience, but unfortunately the behavior of the staff was extremely disappointing. The employees were very rude, unprofessional, and lacked basic communication skills. Instead of helping customers politely, they spoke in an arrogant tone and showed no interest in assisting properly. It felt as if customers were a burden to them rather than valued visitors. Good customer service is one of the most important parts of any business, especially in retail, but this shop completely failed in that aspect. The staff members need proper training on how to speak respectfully, handle customers patiently, and maintain a positive attitude. Because of this poor experience, I would hesitate to visit the shop again or recommend it to others.

name: REPLAY Store, Jio World Drive, BKC, Bandra
description:
Founded in 1981 and based out of Italy, Replay has been synonymous with high standards in denim production for almost 40 years. An innovative touch, distinctive Italian flare and the superb quality of its products have always been the three cornerstones of Replay’s philosophy. Together with its talent and competence, these have made the Italian group a major player in the International arena of premium denim and casualwear and proudly creates, promotes and distributes casualwear, accessories and footwear for men and women.
We believe Jeans are more than just a piece of clothing. They do not only last for a season. Jeans blend with the body, are moulded by the body into an indissoluble whole, becoming one with the wearer.
